source.title: City of Cambridge FY2026 Adopted Budget

meta.note: Cambridge's FY2026 adopted operating budget. The bars below are the General Fund (978,578,370), where the by-department money lives; a separate Water enterprise fund (13,602,950) and a 151,140,770 capital budget are appropriated on their own. Every department figure is from the adopted appropriation ordinance and they add up to the General Fund total exactly.
facts: Schools are about 28% of the budget — $280.25M, the single largest line.
Cambridge is rated AAA by all three major agencies (Fitch, Moody's, S&P) — a rare triple-AAA.
Property taxes fund about 72% of the General Fund; the FY26 levy is $678.7M.
